cards.text: Through Isaiah the prophet, the LORD has just promised new heavens and a new earth (Isaiah 65:17). Now He speaks again, and He starts BIG: 'Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool.'
Then He asks two questions: 'What kind of house will you build for Me? Or where will My place of repose be?'

cards.question: Right after asking about a house, the LORD asks another question. True or false: He says His own hand made all these things.
The LORD made all these things, and then He names the one He will esteem. Who is it?

answers.text: The humble one who trembles at His word
The one who brings the grandest offerings
The one with the most famous name

cards.text: Then the LORD talks about people bringing offerings. Whoever slaughters an ox is like one who slays a man, and whoever sacrifices a lamb is like one who breaks a dog's neck.
Whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig's blood, and whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol. Friend, that is a hard list to hear.

cards.question: These people ARE bringing offerings. What does the LORD say about them?

answers.text: They have chosen their own ways
They offer on the wrong days

cards.question: These people chose their own ways and delighted in their abominations. So the LORD says He will choose their ___.
The LORD says He will bring terror upon these people. What reason does He give?

answers.text: He called and no one answered
They moved to a far country

cards.text: That's letting somebody's call ring through to voicemail EVERY single time. And instead, they did evil in His sight and chose what He did not delight in.

cards.question: Now the word of the LORD goes out to those who tremble at His word. Why do their brothers hate them and exclude them?
Those brothers say, 'Let the LORD be glorified that we may see your joy!' What does the LORD say will happen to those brothers?

answers.text: They will be put to shame
They will be left in peace

cards.question: Then the call comes: 'Hear the uproar from the city; listen to the voice from the temple!' True or false: It is the voice of the city's watchmen.

cards.text: It's the voice of the LORD, repaying His enemies what they deserve.
Then the LORD paints a picture: 'Before she was in labor, she gave birth; before she was in pain, she delivered a boy.' No labor, no pain, and there's the baby.

cards.question: After that birth, the LORD asks about it. True or false: He says people hear about things like this all the time.

cards.text: Then He asks, 'Can a country be born in a day or a nation be delivered in an instant?' A whole NATION. In ONE day. Friend, WHAT?

cards.question: Right after asking if a nation can be delivered in an instant, the LORD names the mother in this picture. Who is she?

cards.text: Zion, a name for Jerusalem: as soon as she was in labor, she gave birth to her children. Then the LORD asks, 'Shall I bring a baby to the point of birth and not deliver it?'

cards.question: The LORD asks if He would bring a baby to the point of birth and not deliver it. What answer does His question point to?

answers.text: He will make it wait longer

cards.text: He won't stop halfway, friend. Then the call goes out: be glad for Jerusalem and rejoice over her, all who love her.

cards.question: The call to rejoice over Jerusalem keeps going. True or false: Even those who mourn over her are told to rejoice greatly with her.

cards.text: Why rejoice? So that they may nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts, and drink deeply and delight themselves in her glorious abundance.
Then the LORD says He will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flowing stream. Not a drip, not a trickle, friend, a RIVER.

cards.question: In the LORD's picture, those who love Jerusalem are like little ones with her. What happens to them?

answers.text: They are carried on her arm
They are sent off to her fields
They are left outside her gates

cards.question: Now the LORD says He Himself will comfort those who love Jerusalem. True or false: He says He will comfort them as a mother comforts her son.
Comforted like that, they will be consoled over Jerusalem. And when they see, they will rejoice. What does the LORD say they will flourish like?

cards.text: Grass, friend. You mow grass on Saturday, and by Wednesday it's back and laughing at you.

cards.question: Then the hand of the LORD will be revealed. True or false: His wrath will be shown to His servants.

cards.text: His hand will be revealed to His servants, and His wrath will be shown to His enemies. Friend, I know which side of that line I want to be on.
